_what: PH pilot harness run plan, Phase 2' (R-C9-188/189): the bv2art 5x5 grid, cols 0-2 x rows 0-2, plate px [0,0,4096,2560] at 100.6176 px/m, kept, built in-engine. Bars are FROZEN as calibrated (calibration.md); nothing is re-derived from the pilot.

requested_from_PT.painting: fid/pt/pilot/painting.png (the stitched pilot, plate px of the window) + its sha in the stitch record
requested_from_PT.canvases: the 9 raw Astra canvases (artifact prefix + keys c_r) and the stitch's seam record
requested_from_PT.lineage: fid/pt/pilot/lineage.json in the p2_lineage.py schema (every static texture -> producing tool record -> the pilot painting sha)
requested_from_PT.bake_report: fid/pt/pilot/bake_report.json (t5_06b_bake per hero: texels_on_mesh, unseen_before_fill_pct, silhouette_px_in_cell, as v1's take/build/bake_report.json)
requested_from_PT.guide_camera_render: fid/pt/pilot/render_guide.png + heather_mask.png: the built pilot at the guide/paint camera over the window, painted, as played, him absent, falling snow hidden, wind held (v1's capture_painted.gd --guide recipe)
requested_from_PT.ids_built: fid/pt/pilot/ids_built.png: v1 capture_ids at the same camera on the built pilot (for P6' on the build; else the blockout ids_art.png window is used, geometry unchanged)

P1.tool: harness/p1_density.py (pilot set: painting ppm from the frame + per-hero bake texel density)

P2.bar: 100% resolve to the pilot painting sha

P3.tool: harness/p3_residual.py (pilot inputs: render_guide.png + heather_mask.png; classes from guide_art/class_art.png + ids_art.png cropped to the window)

P4.tool: harness/p4_texture.py (pilot chunks = the 9 canvases' stitched rects; classes from class_art)
P4.bar: v1 leave-one-out maxima (snow, rock, ice); new classes per the W-5 re-home (advisory until ruled)

P5.tool: harness/p5_seams.py (the 9 raw canvases + the stitched pilot)

P6a.tool: harness/p6_geometry.py openings (v0.1, T = 32) + harness/p6_overlay.py triage (layout-projected declared-opening overlay, jsonl record) -> results/p6a_triage_pilot.jsonl; the conductor reads by eye (§ 13 protocol, fallback (a))
P6a.dark_structures_in_window: none (char/ash share 0 in the window): every candidate that matches no declared opening fails its chunk

P6prime.tool: harness/p6prime_art.py (presence / placement / scale; frozen bars) on ids_built if supplied, else ids_art

P8.tool: harness/p7_p8_floor_heather.py precision per chunk (heather_mask.png vs the pilot painting's tuft classifier)

P9.tool: harness/godot/ph_life.gd life on res://scenes/bv2f_barrow_v2.tscn (BV2F_VARIANT=art) at a pilot view (the mere edge) + a --no-wind RED; water flow only where open water is in the window (sea 3.5% of the window, W coast); floe drift N/A until DEV-5; snow trail coverage of the pilot's walkable snow

P10.tool: harness/godot/ph_life.gd perf on the art scene, him walking a loop at the start (uv 0,0)

P11.tool: harness/p11_abx.py build (SETS -> the 12 pilot stills), the conductor's fresh judge, p11_abx.py score
P11.bar: ABX accuracy <= 65% (<= 26/40), judge void if repeat inconsistency > 25%; UNDERPOWERED (< 40) = VOID

godot_runs: all behind heavy_lock C-9 and the 21 GiB disk gate (harness/run_godot_queue.sh pattern); ph_capture.gd is v2sw-frame specific and is NOT used for the pilot (P3 input comes from PT's guide-camera render)
